BiblicalUsage: Bigtha means in the wine-press, and he is named once, among the seven chamberlains of King Ahasuerus. In Esther 1:10, on the seventh day of the feast, when the king's heart was merry with wine, he commanded Bigtha and six others to bring Queen Vashti before him. A court servant, called on a day of wine and pride.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bigtha's one verse opens the whole book of Esther: a king's command, a queen's refusal, and God moving behind it all.
